title: Box breathing
steps: Breathe in for 4 counts
Hold for 4
Out for 4
Hold for 4 — repeat 6 times

title: 5-4-3-2-1 grounding
steps: Name 5 things you can see
4 you can touch
3 you can hear
2 you can smell
1 you can taste

title: Write the worry down
steps: Write the worry in one sentence
Write what is in your control and what isn't
Pick one small next step for the controllable part

title: One tiny next step
steps: Name the task that feels biggest
Split off a 5-minute piece
Do only that piece, then stop

title: Check the thought
steps: Write the thought exactly as it appeared
What is the evidence for and against it?
Write a more balanced version

title: Screen-off wind-down
steps: Dim the lights
Put the phone in another room
Do a slow body scan from feet to head

title: Two-line sleep note
steps: Note when you got into bed and when you woke
Note one thing that helped or hurt

title: Five-minute walk
steps: Stand up now
Walk anywhere for 5 minutes, no destination
Notice one thing outside your head

title: Three good things
steps: Write three things that went okay today
For one, write why it happened

title: Say it plainly
steps: Write what happened, without judgment
Write how you felt
Write one sentence you could say to them
